notes: Small Nazarene fellowship in Tucson. Address (7335 N. Camino de Oeste, Tucson AZ 85741), staff list and YouTube channel were all confirmed on the church's own site on 2026-09-10. The staff page names the pastor as 'Rev. Samuel A. Hall'; the rest of the site calls him 'Pastor Sam Hall' - the same person. Other staff listed (Darleen Hall, worship leader; Rachel Hall and Andra Cochran, children's ministry; Garrett Hall, high school ministry) are not described as preachers, so only Samuel Hall is recorded as a preaching pastor. The sermons page simply points to the church's YouTube channel, so YouTube is the sermon corpus; caption availability has not been tested. Coordinates not set - run tools/geocode.py.
